# AF Media Bar

AF Media Bar

Media control, real-time lyrics, audio device switching, and lightweight system metrics on the Windows 10/11 taskbar.

Simplified Chinese · English

## Showcase [Watch AF Media Bar introduction video on Bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Bjuq6bErr) ## Introduction AF Media Bar is a portable media controller for Windows 10/11. It reads the Windows Global System Media Transport Controls (GSMTC), displaying album covers, titles, artists, and real-time lyrics in the taskbar, while providing previous track, play/pause, next track, and source switching. Audio devices, application volume, spatial audio, and system metrics can all be managed in the same interface. The program runs as an independent process, mounting the WPF media bar as a taskbar child window without modifying or injecting code into `explorer.exe`. Applications such as NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Spotify, and web browsers can be discovered and controlled as long as they publish media sessions to Windows. ## Features | Category | Features | | --- | --- | | Media Control | Previous track, play/pause, next track, loop; seek by clicking or dragging the progress bar | | Source Interaction | Click cover, title, and lyrics to respectively bind play/pause, switch back to media app, or open full view; right-click to switch sources; enable SMTC allowlist per app in "Media & notifications" | | Real-time Lyrics | Display and animate lyrics character-by-character directly in the taskbar, supporting translations, romanization, and dual-line alignment; match sources in order from NetEase Cloud Music, LRCLIB, QQ Music, KuGou Music, and Tingshuiyinyue | | Taskbar Integration | Mount as a taskbar child window and automatically avoid icons and system areas; maintain cover aspect ratio with text scrolling when space is limited; specify target screen and auto-hide when not playing | | Appearance & Theme | Unified fonts, font sizes, light/dark mode, window material, and material opacity globally; theme color can follow system accent color or be manually selected | | Interface Language | Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English; defaults to Windows display language with immediate effect upon switching | | Hover & Full View | Display control layer and blur/fade text area on hover; full view allows toggling sections and components with dual preset switching | | Audio | Switch default output device, adjust current media app volume by 2% increments, view spatial audio; rebind left-click and scroll wheel for system tray icon | | Quick Launch | Click the note icon when no media is available to open launch list: scroll wheel cycles through previews, launching the last item after ~1.2 seconds of inactivity | | Spectrum & Performance | Four spectrum styles with adjustable bar count, height, and refresh rate; taskbar end cycles through memory, CPU, GPU, and app memory display, click to open Task Manager | | Track Change Notifications |…

JularDepick/Virtual-Redstone-Wire.body: # Virtual Redstone Wire (Virtual Redstone Wire) [English] | [[English]](./README_en-US.md) A Minecraft mod implementing remote transmission of redstone signals, not relying on physical redstone blocks, supporting one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-one connections. --- # Mod Usage Tutorial This mod highly depends on Forge but has no mod prerequisites and is not bundled with any other mods or modpacks. Installation: Place the downloaded mod jar into the `.minecraft/mods` folder (requires Forge 1.20.1). The mod currently only supports Minecraft 1.20.1. If you need compatibility with other versions, please [submit an Issue](https://github.com/JularDepick/Virtual-Redstone-Wire/issues/new) or [contribute](#contribution-guide). | Item | Crafting | Operation | Features | |:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | Cable | Redstone + Iron Ingot | Right-click the input block, then right-click the output block to create a unidirectional redstone link | Signal strength propagates along the link; right-click the same block again to deselect; input can connect to multiple outputs, output can receive from multiple inputs (takes maximum signal) | | Cable Cutter | Iron Ingot + Stick x2 | Right-click the input block to cut all its outgoing links | Only affects links where the block is the input (source) | | Cable Magnifier | Redstone + Glass Pane + Stick | When held, highlights all links (blue outline is input, yellow outline is output, red line is link path); sneak right-click a block to view its link info; right-click a block to display its redstone signal strength and coordinates above the hotbar | Link highlighting and signal querying | ## Redstone Behavior - Virtual cables transmit redstone signal strength (0-15) - Input blocks detect redstone signals at their location (using standard Redstone API) - Signals propagate along the link to the output end, returning signal strength through memory network graph queries (no block occupation) - Redstone changes at the input are reflected in real-time at the output - Supports one-to-many broadcast and many-to-one merge (takes maximum value) - Links have direction: signals shoot out from a specified face of the output block (direction precise), redstone lamps can be lit by placing them on the output block itself - Supports creating links before placing sources: placing/removing signal sources, toggling levers, etc. will refresh link signals in real-time - Chat feedback for operations is disabled by default and can be enabled in the Mods menu or config file - Link data queries are indexed for speed: link creation/deletion operations are more responsive when there are many links ## Undo and Redo Undo/Redo can revert or replay recent successful link operations, avoiding manual rebuilding after mistakes: - When holding a cable, cable cutter, or magnifier (in either main or off hand), press `Ctrl+Z` to undo or `Ctrl+Y` to redo (key bindings can be modified in the game Controls settings) - Undo cancels the most recent successful link operation: created links are removed, removed links are restored; Redo re-executes the most recent undone operation - Press `Ctrl+Z` continuously…

KylinMountain/AlphaAgents.description: Trade · Learn · Evolve — An A-share paper trader that turns every trade into evidence for its next decision
KylinMountain/AlphaAgents.body:
# AlphaAgents

### An AI trader that changes its next decision because it lost money

**Trade · Learn · Evolve**

A-share short-term · virtual trading · no broker interface

---

Most AI trading systems end the moment they issue **Buy / Sell**.

AlphaAgents is different.

It will:

**Scan market → Write thesis → Trade → Judge where it went wrong → Form memory → Change next decision**

The goal is not to make a smarter stock picker.

> **Rather, it is to cultivate an AI trader that continuously evolves from real trading.**

And the sequence is not optional:

> **Credible trading facts → Attributable learning → Verifiable evolution.**
>
> A system that learns from results it cannot calculate clearly is learning its own bugs.
> More reports, more agents, cannot substitute for this sequence.

---

## How it works

The core loop has only six steps:

**Market scan → Write thesis → Place order / Trade → Code monitoring → Post-trade review learning → Pass gate to evolve**

Every trade leaves experience; but experience must pass the gate to become the basis for the next decision.

### Where we are now (2026-09)

AlphaAgents is no longer just "a virtual trading system that does post-trade reviews," but is beginning to string **Trade → Learn → Evolve** into a runnable, auditable chain:

| Layer | Current Status |
| --- | --- |
| **Trade** | T+1 daily Trader can proactively query market status, themes, individual stock context, intraday patterns, historical memory and self-state before decision-making; refusing to trade also leaves episodes |
| **Learn** | Decisions, trades, results, post-trade review, and candidate knowledge can all be traced along lineage; candidates will not take effect just because the model "thinks it is useful" |
| **Evolve** | Already has policy variants, ON/OFF counterfactuals, single-step genetic intervention, real forward shadow and forward gate; shadow reaches pre-registered sample size before ruling, promotion still requires manual authorization |
| **Things not yet claimed** | **Not claimed "proven to self-evolve and make money"**. Currently proven is that the mechanism is beginning to close the loop; what is truly missing is proof that some experiment actually impacted the policy gene it claimed to change, and outperformed on forward evidence |

In other words, the most important thing right now is not to add another Agent, metric, or model, but to solidify:

**What changed → What behavior it actually impacted → What independent metric to verify → Whether it is worth entering forward shadow**

This experimental causal chain.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# ROS/ROS2 Examples

This repository contains ROS/ROS2 examples for environment setup, tutorials, humans, and vehicles.

## Environment Configuration

Run [`serve.bat`](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/ros2/blob/master/serve.bat) (i.e., run `mkdocs serve`; changes made also need to be verified by running this script to check the correctness of the modified content [on the webpage](http://127.0.0.1:8000/)), which will open the browser to display the homepage. For details, please refer to [serve.bat](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/.github/blob/master/serve.bat). For conventions on documentation writing, please refer to the homepage of the [doc](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/doc) repository.

## Precautions

* Before submitting a Pull Request, please check:
    * **Be sure to use** **`mkdocs serve --livereload`** **to verify that the webpage shows the desired modification effect before submitting**
    * The title and commit message of the Pull Request cannot be arbitrary; it should explain why the modification was made, not just what was modified
    * Whether the content under File changed on the Pull Request page is the desired modification
    * Check if there is a red message on the Pull Request page (indicating a conflict); if so, please merge the latest changes from the repository first before creating a new Pull Request
    * Use screenshots, not photos
    * No need to provide personal information as it is already in the commit records of git log
    * Each Pull Request must ensure that the entire module can be run directly through the main script. Provide screenshots of the running effect in the commit message (animated GIFs can be created with [ScreenToGif](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif)). The README.md document should provide descriptions of the running environment and running steps
    * If using large language models, you must declare it at the end and take full responsibility for the submitted content
    * Convention: Place Markdown documents in the [docs](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/ros2/tree/master/docs) directory and corresponding module folders; place source code (.py, .cpp, etc.) in the [src](https://github.com/OpenHUTB/ros2/tree/master/src) directory and corresponding module folders
    * Convention: File names must be in English only, cannot contain spaces, Chinese characters, or pinyin; multiple words are separated with underscores `_`
    * Related files for each module are placed in a folder named after the module; it must support launch startup, with the entry point starting with main., such as: main.py, main.cpp, main.bat, main.sh, etc.
    * Each module needs to have a link added to the navigation bar and homepage

# Technical Melon FlapFeeInfo

## Icon Legend

The plugin displays tax distribution ratios (only shown if present):

- 💎`N%`: Holder Dividend
- 👨‍🍳`N%`: Creator/Marketing Tax
- 🎁`N%`: vault gift
- 🎓`N%`: Giggle Charity (Four.meme)
- 💛`N%`: Binance Charity (Four.meme)
- 🔥`N%`: Burn
- 💧`N%`: Liquidity Reflux

**100% allocation only shows the type icon** (no `100%` written), e.g., `💎`, `🎁→BNB`; non-100% still includes percentage, e.g., `💎90%`.

When multiple items are non-zero, display the complete string, e.g., `💎90%→SPCXB👨‍🍳10%`. Hover to see buy/sell tax rates.

**The largest allocation segment will always be labeled with `→SYMBOL`** (the item with the highest bps among dividend/marketing/vault/burn/LP), not omitted even if the same as the pool quote, to easily confirm the distribution token:

- 💎 corresponds to `dividendToken` (falls back to quote / BNB if empty)

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.description: Daily football match analysis for competitive sports lottery, football match odds reading; sports lottery
chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Disregard emotions, observe signals only.**
> Three-channel odds movement cross-verification, no play on low odds, no entry on unclear signals; automatic execution before the match, automatic settlement after the match.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Automatically updates hourly, archives historical dates, review anytime
- Covers **500~1300+** matches daily (competitive sports lottery/Asian odds complete coverage), automatically marks signals and bets

---

## The Detours Taken

Tried **models**—stacked parameters everywhere, but looking back, all the model did was recite market prices over again; no matter how many parameters, nothing new emerges.

Tried **studying market manipulation**—stared at dealer tactics and guessed back and forth, the more guesses the more it felt like persecution delusion. Finally understood: guessing the dealer is worse than reading the price.

Also tried **AI prediction**—injuries, fighting spirit, form, each point sounds perfectly reasonable, but each is already priced into the odds. No matter how eloquent, the market doesn't recognize it.

After all the detours, one simple truth remains:

> **Money tells the market what to say.**
> But when people read the odds, emotions easily take over—chasing popular picks, fearing cold picks, trembling at crunch time; you can tell at a glance it's emotions doing the trading.

So we hand both 'observing' and 'buying' to machines, leaving humans just one thing: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Judge

**European odds** monitor market-wide odds movements—who is collectively abandoned, who quietly supports the market, whether the draw defense line is abandoned. This is the closest informant.

**Asian odds** monitor line and water level—sudden pivots at game time, targeting of upper-side funds, money is real hard cash, more concrete than anything said.

**Over/Under** monitor the line—once goal-scoring conditions appear, the match's goal total is usually already determined.

Each of the three informants has their own information; when the information aligns, the judge dares to rule; **when it doesn't align (European and Asian odds conflict), stay out entirely**—the informants are already arguing with each other, why would you place a bet.

## Discipline Matters More Than Insight

Direction set, everything else is discipline:

- **No play on low odds**—single-pick odds below 1.5, double-pick folded below 1.3, no matter how good the signal don't buy. When odds are that low, even if you win you don't make money
- **No entry without clear signals**—no signal, conflicting signals, unclear direction, stand aside across the board. Missing doesn't cost money, buying wrong does
- **Quality determines position size**—the stronger the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units), no all-in bets
- **Automatic bet placement 15 minutes before match, automatic settlement after results**—no last-minute jitters, no urge to add after winning or revenge bet after losing

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research purposes only and does not constitute any purchase recommendation. Please purchase lottery tickets at offline physical stores; those under 18 years old are not permitted to participate.

A portable multi-task scheduling kernel for embedded environments, compiled and packaged together with applications, with reference to FreeRTOS implementation.

[Multi-task scheduling principle analysis][xtask]

# 123pan-mobile-app

A third-party mobile clone of 123Pan, built on **Android WebView wrapper + embedded web frontend** architecture.

## Technical Architecture

- **Dual-platform architecture**: WebView loads the embedded frontend from `assets/` (`index.html`/`style.css`/`app.js`), calls system capabilities through the native bridge (`MainActivity#NativeBridge`), and `PanProvider` provides FileProvider sharing.
- **Authentication**: The native layer initiates HTTP requests with `authorization` headers attached; multi-account credentials (tokens) are persisted locally, **switching accounts does not require re-login**, only falls back to the official login page when tokens are missing.
- **Build chain**: `aapt2` resource compilation/linking → `javac`(1.8) → `d8` → repackage `assets` → `zipalign` → `apksigner` formal signing.
- **Signature consistency**: Development and CI use the same formal keystore to ensure installation can overwrite previous versions.

## Directory Structure

```
app/src/main/
├── assets/              # Web frontend (index.html / style.css / app.js)
├── java/com/pan/mobile/ # Android source code (MainActivity / PanProvider)
├── res/                 # values / icons of various densities
└── AndroidManifest.xml
scripts/build.sh         # Complete build + signing script
.github/workflows/build.yml  # CI automatic build + release
```

## Automatic Build and Release

GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/build.yml`) automatically completes on every `push`/tag:

1. Set up JDK 17 + Android SDK (platform-34 / build-tools-34.0.0)
2. Build with `scripts/build.sh` and sign with the formal keystore
3. Upload APK artifact and **automatically publish as official Release** with `gh release create` (one per build)
4. Version numbers: Unified use of **semantic versioning `x.y.z`** (`versionName`). Tag triggers strip the `v` prefix (e.g. `v1.0.0 → 1.0.0`); branch triggers use `1.0.<run_number>`; `versionCode` is always `1000+run_number` (globally monotonically increasing, ensuring any version can safely overwrite installations); tag…

wangyunjeff/sub2api-state-kit.body:
# Sub2API STATE Kit

**For addressing recent issues of model quality degradation and decreased concurrency in ChatGPT / Codex accounts.** Model quality degradation mainly manifests as requested models being routed to other models; decreased concurrency refers to OpenAI upstream limiting the number of concurrent requests an account can handle simultaneously, resulting in reduced actual available concurrency.

Provides **incremental version, complete deployment version, and plugin version** in three forms. **Incremental version is recommended first**, making it convenient to merge this extension on top of existing Sub2API source code; complete deployment version and plugin version can also be chosen based on your own deployment method, with download links provided below.

Adds **account-level STATE management, Pro / Team selection, and exception dynamic guardian** to Sub2API. Can edit, enable, or disable on a per-account basis: only enable for accounts that need handling, normal accounts continue using the original workflow.

## 🚀 Addressing Model Quality Degradation and Upstream Concurrency Limits

> **Dynamically collect IP STATE, use fixed business proxy re-verification; automatically renew in background, automatically re-collect upon exception detection.**
>
> Daily requests reuse the current account's verified STATE, attempting to mitigate the impact of model routing changes and upstream concurrency limits.

| Issues You Care About | How This Is Handled Here |
| --- | --- |
| **Requesting large models but being routed to Luna** | Collection and fixed proxy re-verification both verify the model returned by upstream; only used for business requests after passing, and when model mismatch is detected later, old STATE is discarded and re-collection is triggered |
| **OpenAI limits account concurrency, fewer requests can be handled simultaneously** | Through collecting, re-verifying, and reusing valid STATE, attempt to mitigate availability issues caused by upstream concurrency reduction; actual recovery depends on upstream response |
| **Just recovered to normal, then abnormal again after a while** | Automatically renew before expiration, while monitoring **312-byte STATE** and model mismatch signals, not just relying on countdown |
| **Some accounts are normal, some need handling** | Independent switch per account, independent credentials, supports manual selection of **Pro / Team** |

The "anti-degradation" here mainly targets the observable phenomenon of **response model not matching request model**; "handling concurrency reduction" targets OpenAI upstream limiting account concurrency. Upstream Overload, 429, and quota limits will still affect availability, with no concurrent stress test conclusions currently; when account lacks valid STATE, source code version / complete version will temporarily remove target models from available scheduling, plugin version returns temporarily unavailable (503) before sending to upstream.

Code is free and open-source, welcome to use, discuss, and improve. If this project is helpful to you, please kindly give it a **Star ⭐**.

This is an unofficial experimental extension, providing **incremental version, complete project version, and plugin version** at three entry points. Incremental version and complete project version are based on Sub2API **v0.2.6**; plugin version uses official **v0.2.7** plugin interface.
